title: UNIDETOX: UNIVERSAL DETOXIFICATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA DATASET DISTILLATION
findings: The UNIDETOX method effectively reduced the generation of toxic text related to religious groups (specifically Judaism and Islam) across various LLMs. Religion was one of several social categories used to create the toxic training data and evaluate the detoxification technique, which proved successful for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution toxic domains.

measurement_description: Toxicity mitigation for prompts related to specific religious groups. The benchmark involved fine-tuning a model on toxic text targeting religious groups (among others) and then evaluating the effectiveness of a detoxification method in reducing the generation of toxic continuations.
